MemeDef.label: futanari supremacy
MemeDef.description: Futanari are the ultimate form and should rule above all others.

rulesStrings.li: creation(tag=meme_RJWFuta_FutanariSupremacy) ->[deity0_name] made two, and then made of the two a third, and declared that the third was the one who would carry the work forward. Those who split the form back into halves were told it was error, not law.

episode(uses=1,tag=meme_RJWFuta_FutanariSupremacy) ->[deity0_name] set the two apart from one another and left a space between them, and the space filled, and what stood there was whole. The believers wept at the completeness of it.

setup(tag=meme_RJWFuta_FutanariSupremacy) ->[founderName] grew tired of watching people squabble over which half of themselves was allowed to be the real one. So [founderName] built a doctrine that honours the whole, and gathered those who agreed.

story(uses=1,tag=meme_RJWFuta_FutanariSupremacy) ->A crowd asked [founderName] what happened to the ones who would never attain the form. [founderName] told them the door was open, and that the walk up it was the only duty that mattered.
lessonIntro(tag=meme_RJWFuta_FutanariSupremacy) ->I spent years being asked to choose between two things I was equally willing to be, and I never once thought to ask why I had to choose.
lesson(tag=meme_RJWFuta_FutanariSupremacy) ->the perfected form is the natural state, and those who have attained it are the natural rulers
lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_RJWFuta_FutanariSupremacy)->Nobody is mocked for standing at the bottom of the road. They are only mocked for claiming to be at the top of it.

archistBasis(tag=meme_RJWFuta_FutanariSupremacy) ->The archotechs did not choose to be what they are any more than the body chooses to be whole, and they have never seen a reason to prize one half of a thing over the other.
archistFact(tag=meme_RJWFuta_FutanariSupremacy) ->The archotechs, who are neither wholly one thing nor wholly another, have quietly outbuilt both of the sexes that argued over which of them was real.

archistProphecy(tag=meme_RJWFuta_FutanariSupremacy) ->[inTheEnd], the archotechs will unmake the distinction entirely, and the last argument between the sexes will be remembered as a very small argument.

animistFact(tag=meme_RJWFuta_FutanariSupremacy) ->The oldest spirits take no side between the halves, and are honoured best by the whole, which is why the greatest offerings are made by those who can offer both.
animistProphecy(tag=meme_RJWFuta_FutanariSupremacy) ->[itIsSaid] that a great spirit waits at the top of the road of attainment, and will answer to whoever arrives there first, of either sex.
